defs.def: at or to a lower level or position than sb/sth 在（或到）… 下面

ex.s: In a matrix garden, plants with similar cultural needs are grouped so that they will grow together above and below ground, forming a cooperative ecosystem that conserves water and discourages weeds.
ex.t: 在矩阵花园中，养护需求相似的植物被组合在一起，使它们在地上地下共同生长，形成一个节约用水、抑制杂草的协作生态系统。

ex.s: This makes a fun activity for a children’s party; they love feeding the fruit and frozen bananas into the top of the machine and watching the ice cream come out below.
ex.t: 这对儿童派对来说是个有趣的活动；他们喜欢把水果和冷冻香蕉从机器顶端投入，看着冰淇淋从下方出来。

ex.s: Directions: After reading the passages below, fill in the blanks to make the passages coherent and grammatically correct.
ex.t: 说明：阅读下面短文后，填空使短文连贯。

ex.s: Merit and his team at Environmental Design installed underneath the root ball a platform of seven-inch-diameter,44-foot-long steelbars and, just below the rods, a first set of uninflated airbags ( shown in gray).The team also dug a shallow ramp.
ex.t: 环境设计公司的梅里特及其团队在根球下方安装了一个平台，由直径7英寸、长44英尺的钢条构成，钢条正下方是第一组未充气的气囊（灰色所示）。团队还挖了一条浅坡道。

ex.s: As it turns out, however, this same concept-one that most consumers make many times each day with reflecting on it-is the basis of the more formal budget line concept in economics , which is explained below.
ex.t: 然而，事实证明，同一个概念——大多数消费者每天都会做出许多次、却不去反思的概念——是经济学中更正式的预算线概念的基础，下文将作解释。

ex.s: Any combination of movies and crime novels that falls below the budget line is affordable.
ex.t: 任何电影和犯罪小说的组合，只要落在预算线以下就是负担得起的。

ex.s: Directions: Write an English composition in 120-150 words according to the instructions given below in Chinese.
ex.t: 说明：根据以下中文提示写一篇120-150词的英语作文。

ex.s: I'd like to know… Tell student B about recycling using the information below.
ex.t: 我想知道…… 用下面的信息告诉学生B关于回收利用的事。

ex.s: You like going to the movies and reading crime novels and you have $ 150 to spend, In the example below, assume that each movie costs $10 and each crime novel costs $15.
ex.t: 你喜欢看电影和读犯罪小说，有150美元可花。在下面的例子中，假设每部电影10美元，每本犯罪小说15美元。

ex.s: An eagle flew over the snow-capped mountains, which were reflected in the still lake below.
ex.t: 一只鹰飞越白雪皑皑的山峰，山峰倒映在下方平静的湖水中。

ex.s: The mountains were reflected in the still lake below.
ex.t: 山峰倒映在下方平静的湖水中。

defs.def: of a lower amount or standard than sb/sth （数量）少于；（标准）低于

ex.s: Second, if other factors such as technology remain constant, economic growth and material expectations will fall well below recent standards and this could invite trouble.
ex.t: 其次，如果技术等其他因素保持不变，经济增长和物质期望将远低于近期标准，这可能引发麻烦。

ex.s: Furthermore, around 50% of the world’s population live in regions where the figure is now below the replacement level (ie 2.1 births per woman) and almost all developed nations are experiencing sub-replacement birth rate.
ex.t: 此外，约50%的世界人口生活在生育率目前低于替代水平（即每名女性2.1个孩子）的地区，几乎所有发达国家都在经历低于替代水平的生育率。

defs.def: of a lower rank or of less importance than sb/sth （级别、重要性）低于
at or to a lower level, position or place 在（或到）下面

ex.s: Key actions Personal qualities 2 Organise your talk following the steps below.
ex.t: 关键行动 个人品质 2 按照以下步骤组织你的演讲。

defs.def: at a lower rank 下级
